E1.evidence: Public issue with launch-file excerpt and launch log showing SIGINT->SIGTERM->SIGKILL escalation ("failed to terminate '5' seconds after receiving 'SIGINT', escalating to 'SIGTERM'"); maintainer mjcarroll: "I now have a minimal reproduction example using a component with a single timer and publication" and isolated the hang: "In the isolated case, we end up blocking on a `sem_wait` and the semaphore never gets posted to because `Signalhandler::uninstall` never seems to get called." https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/issues/2083

units_identified: loaded components (nav2 composable nodes in the report; any component per the maintainer reproduction)
E2.evidence: The hang is an infinite wait loop inside ComponentManagerIsolated::cancel_executor in rclcpp_components, which waits for its own dedicated executor to report is_spinning() after context shutdown had already made spin() return. PR #2085: "The issue is that there is a race where the executor is already shutdown/cancelled (so is_spinning is always false), causing an infinite loop." The pre-fix code comment states the assumption is about the class's own behaviour: "We rely on the assumption that this class creates executors and then immediately makes them" / "spin in a separate thread" (https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/blob/37adc03c11171f67c213ee72f7ce43fdcbda7b9e/rclcpp_components/include/rclcpp_components/component_manager_isolated.hpp). The failure occurs with any loaded component: the reporter dujeong: "I also had the same problem when using non-Nav2 component", and mjcarroll reproduced it "using a component with a single timer and publication". No value, name, frame or timing crosses a boundary to a peer; the executor (rclcpp) behaves as designed by returning from spin() on context shutdown, and both fixes (#2085 rolling, #3282 humble) change only the container's own wait loop ("It only modifies the `cancel_executor()` function body").

E3.evidence: Not evaluated: E2 stopped at step 2 (internal). The observed situation is process shutdown on SIGINT of a running container with loaded components.

E4.evidence: Observed: "[ERROR] [component_container_isolated-13]: process[component_container_isolated-13] failed to terminate '10.0' seconds after receiving 'SIGTERM', escalating to 'SIGKILL'" https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/issues/2083

notes: Alternative reading considered and rejected: rclcpp_components (ComponentManagerIsolated) and rclcpp (Executor::is_spinning/cancel/spin) are separate packages, and mjcarroll attributes the defect partly to "a little bit of under-documentation in the way that the executor's cancel works" (PR #2085 comment). However the executor behaves correctly (spin returns on context shutdown and is_spinning is then false), the loop that never terminates is the container's own logic, and any correct executor would produce the same hang; so the case is classed internal. Fix for rolling: ab71df3ce1d8993e8424e7d0934b2e205284c682 (PR #2085, adds a thread_initialized atomic and an rclcpp::ok(context) guard); not backported to humble because "the addition of the `atomic_bool` to the inner struct definitely breaks ABI" (clalancette). Humble fix: cfdb3b7dcea4a503c0acaa304d033636beeb1dba (PR #3282, 2026-09-22, adds only the rclcpp::ok(context) guard). Reporter: Ubuntu 22.04, humble binaries, cyclonedds.
